title: replay-live 'gh is not installed' case passes in every run, alone and in the full suite
body:
Evidence 2026-11-17: in the full `npm test` of lane-start-slim (.krn/tmp/slim-npmtest.log) the replay-live case "gh is not installed" failed once with exit 69; it passed alone and in two later full runs (t-y0x67za lane report). An order- or environment-dependent test.
Outcome: the case's dependence (PATH, a shared temp dir, or a parallel shard) is named and removed; 20 consecutive full-suite shard runs of test/evals/replay-live.test.ts exit 0.
Proof: a loop of 20 runs of the shard that holds the case prints 20 exit 0 lines.
Files: test/evals/replay-live.test.ts
